decisions.quote: In sum, our findings replicate and extend previous work on religious unbelief and highlight that a data-driven approach such as LCA may be a useful tool to characterize different groups of unbelievers.
decisions.reason: Although the Israeli sample yielded two rather than three latent classes of unbelievers, the authors replicated the profiles and socio-cognitive differences of the two main groups and provide an explicit overall verdict at the end of the Discussion that their findings replicate the original work, which governs under Rule 1.
